lessons.text: The `utc_clock` plugin (at /home/user/.rig/plugins/utc_clock) adds the `utc_now` tool: current UTC time as RFC 3339 text from std::time::SystemTime, no dependencies. To change or extend it, edit its src/lib.rs, check with `cd /home/user/.rig/plugins/utc_clock && cargo test` and `RIG_HOME=/home/user/.rig rig plugin check --build`, then call harness_reload.
lessons.evidence: Created the utc_clock plugin this session: `rig plugin new utc_clock`, replaced the generated demo command in /home/user/.rig/plugins/utc_clock/src/lib.rs with a plain `app.add_tool_with(UtcNow, ...)` tool (no-args, `args_schema::<NoArgs>()`, footprint `Touches::Reads(Scope::Anything)`), verified with `cargo test` in the crate, then `RIG_HOME=/home/user/.rig rig plugin check --build` and harness_reload.
